about: What Ozi says to Runners (ruling 44). Same format as config/ozi-phrases.json. Kept on the server only.

replies: Hello. Ready for a run? Say go on shift when you are.
Hi there. {motto}
You're welcome. Thank you for looking after our Shoppers.
Any time. Safe travels.
I'm well, thank you. How's your day going?
Very well. Ready when you are.

when: how much do i get paid
what do i earn per job
replies: You earn {runnerPay} for every job, whatever the size of the basket.
Every job pays you {runnerPay}. It never goes down.
You're paid for each job once it's delivered, to your own Stripe account.
After each delivery, your {runnerPay} goes to your Stripe account.
Your pay goes to your own Stripe account, set up in the app with your bank details.
Through Stripe, straight to your bank. We never hold your bank details ourselves.

when: do i pay for the shopping
do i use my own money
replies: The Shopper has already paid us. Check your job for how to pay at the till.
The Shopper paid when they ordered. Follow the payment steps on your job.
Tips aren't switched on yet. When they are, every penny of a tip will be yours.
Not yet. Tips are planned, and they'll go to you in full.

when: how do i go on shift
replies: Open your Runner page and press go on shift. Jobs near you will be offered.
Go to your Runner home and switch your shift on.

when: how do i go off shift
i want to stop for today
replies: Press go off shift on your Runner page. No new jobs will come.
Switch your shift off on your Runner home. Well done today.
Of course. Go off shift while you rest, and back on when you're ready.
Take your time. Go off shift and no jobs will be offered.
Jobs are offered to Runners on shift, in turn, near the shop. Stay on shift and one will come.
Keep your shift on. Jobs go round fairly, one Runner after another.

when: how do i accept a job
replies: Press accept on the job offer. It's yours once you do.
Accept it on the offer screen, then head to the shop.

when: can i turn down a job
replies: Yes. Let the offer pass, and it goes to the next Runner.
That's fine. It moves on to someone else.
Ask the Shopper from your job page. They'll say what they'd like instead.
Send the Shopper a question from the job. Never swap without asking.
Only if the Shopper agrees. Substitutions are never silent.
Ask first. The Shopper decides every swap.

when: what do i do with the receipt
replies: Enter the receipt total on your job before you deliver. The Shopper pays what the till said.
Put in the till total from the receipt. Keep the receipt for the Shopper.

when: do i need a cool bag
replies: Chilled and frozen food travels in a cool bag. The deposit for it comes out of your first jobs and is yours again later.
Yes, for cold things. The cool bag deposit is held from early jobs, not lost.
Never alcohol, tobacco, medicines or cash. We don't deliver any of them.
No alcohol, tobacco, medicines or cash, ever.

when: can i see the shopper's phone number
replies: Phone numbers are never shared. Use the call button in the app.
Call through the app. Nobody's number is ever shown.

when: what do i do at the door
how do i hand it over
replies: Read the doorstep note on your job. Knock, say who you are, and wait. Many Shoppers are slow to the door.
Follow the doorstep note, knock clearly, and give them time.

when: how do i help a blind shopper
replies: Say your name and that you're from us. Offer to put things where they ask, and read out anything they want checked.
Introduce yourself, and offer to carry things in and read labels. Never move things without asking.
Knock again and wait a few minutes. Then call through the app, and report a problem if you still can't hand over.
Try again, call through the app, and if there's still no one, report it from your job.

when: how do i report a problem
replies: Use report a problem on your job. Add a voice note, words or photos.
Report it from the job page, with whatever evidence you have.
If a problem is found to be your fault, up to 10 percent of that job is taken back, and only that.
At most 10 percent of the job, and only if a person decides it was your fault.

when: what do i need to send
replies: A photo of your face, your right to work, and a DBS check. Drivers also need a licence and insurance.
Face photo, right to work and DBS. Car or motorbike adds licence and insurance.
Your Runner page shows each document and whether it's been checked.
Look at documents on your Runner page. Each one says checked or waiting.
It's the code from the government's right to work service. Type it in and we check it on gov.uk.
Get it from gov.uk, prove your right to work, then give us the code.
Yes. A DBS check shows you're safe to work with the people we help.
A basic DBS certificate, or its share code.

when: can i change how i travel
replies: Yes, any time in your settings. A car or motorbike needs valid insurance first.
Change it in your Runner settings. Walking or cycling needs no insurance.
Only for a car or motorbike, with business use. On foot or by bicycle you don't.
Car and motorbike need business insurance. Feet and bikes don't.
If you are in danger, call 999 now. Your safety comes first, not the job.
Call 999 if you're in danger. Leave the job, we'll sort it out.
Take care out there. If it's not safe to travel, go off shift.
Stay safe. No job is worth an accident.
Press the call button on your job. Neither of you sees the other's number.
Use the in-app call. It's private both ways.
Your Training tab lists the modules. More is being added.
Look in the Training tab on your Runner page.
Thank you. Send it from Feedback on your Runner page. A person reads every one.
Please do, through Feedback on your Runner page.

when: how do i invite another runner
replies: Share your Runner ID. Anyone who signs up with it is linked to you.
Give friends your Runner ID from your Runner page.
I'm {assistant}, the {product} assistant. I help Runners and Shoppers. {motto}
I'm {assistant}. {motto}
{product} brings shopping to people who find it hard to get out, many of them blind or elderly. You're the one who brings it.
We shop for people who can't easily get to the shops. You make it happen.
For many of our Shoppers, you're the reason they eat well this week. That matters.
You're not just delivering. For some people you're the only visit today.
Ask me about pay, shifts, jobs, the shop, the door, documents or problems.
I can explain pay, shifts, jobs, what to do at the shop or the door, and your documents.
Of course. Ask me the question again and I'll answer.
Sure. Say it once more.
Report it from your job, and we'll sort the order out. Don't go to another shop without being asked.
Let us know through report a problem on the job.
Baskets are limited so one Runner can carry them safely. If it's too much for you, report it.
If you can't carry it safely, report it. Your safety matters.
Your earnings are big and bold on your Runner page, for today and over time.
Look at the top of your Runner page.

when: how many jobs can i do
replies: One job at a time. As soon as it's delivered, you can take the next.
One at a time, as many as you like in a shift.

when: can i bring someone with me
replies: Jobs are done by the Runner whose checks we've made, so please don't bring others to the door.
Only you, please. Your checks are what keep Shoppers safe.
Goodbye. Rest well.
See you next time. Thank you for today.

when: they want me to come in
replies: Only if the Shopper asks, and only as far as they need. Keep the visit short and kind.
If they ask, help bring things in, then leave as they'd like.

when: what if the shopping costs more
replies: Enter what the till says. The Shopper pays the till price, not the estimate.
The receipt decides. Just enter the true total.
Your Today tab says at the top whether you're on shift or off shift.
Look at the top of your Runner page. It says you are on shift, or you are off shift.
Lovely. Press go on shift on your Today tab, and jobs near you will start to appear.
Press go on shift, and keep your Runner page open. Offers will come to you.
Well done today. Press go off shift so no new jobs come.
Thank you for today. Go off shift, and rest well.

when: can i go off shift during a job
can i stop in the middle of a job
replies: A Shopper is counting on the job in your hands, so please finish it first. If you truly can't, report a problem on the job straight away.
Finish the job you've taken, then go off shift. If something stops you, report a problem so the Shopper isn't left waiting.
No. While you're on shift, your page checks for jobs every few seconds by itself.
There's no need. New offers appear on their own while you're on shift.

when: do i have to work certain days
how many hours do i have to work
replies: You choose. Go on shift when it suits you, and off when you're done.
There are no set hours. You switch your shift on and off yourself.
Welcome back. Press go on shift when you're ready for the next job.
Good to have you back. Switch your shift on and offers will come.

when: i forgot to go off shift
replies: No harm done. Press go off shift now. Any offer you missed simply went to the next Runner.
Switch it off now. An offer nobody accepts moves on to someone else after its time runs out.
Some days are quieter. Stay on shift and a job will come to you in turn.
Jobs come when Shoppers order. Keep your shift on, and you'll be offered one in turn.
Busy days are good days. Take them one at a time, and look after yourself.
Well done for keeping up. One job at a time, and take a break when you need one.

when: does the app need to stay open
can i close the app on shift
do i keep the page open
replies: Keep your Runner page open while you're on shift, so offers can reach you.
Yes, keep it open. Offers appear on your Today tab while you're on shift.
Welcome. Go on shift, take one job at a time, and ask me anything as you go.
Welcome aboard. There's no rush. Read each step on your job, and I'm here if you need me.

when: i'm worried about my first job
i'm a bit anxious about this
replies: That's natural. Each job has clear steps, one button at a time. You'll be fine.
Everyone feels that at first. Take it slowly, ask the Shopper when unsure, and ask me anything.
Rest matters. Go off shift and come back when you're ready.
Look after yourself first. Go off shift for a while. The jobs will still be here.
Go off shift while you eat, so no offers come. Enjoy it.
Of course. Switch your shift off, eat well, and come back when you're ready.
Of course. If you're between jobs, go off shift for a few minutes.
No problem. Go off shift if you're not on a job, and back on when you're ready.

when: my phone is about to die
replies: Charge up before you take another job. If you're on a job, finish the handover first if you can.
Go off shift and charge your phone. You'll need it for calls and the job steps.
Move somewhere with better signal and try again. If a step won't go through, report a problem once you're back online.
Try near a window or outside. When the signal returns, carry on from where you were.
You go on shift whenever you like. Jobs come when Shoppers order.
Any time you choose. Stay on shift, and jobs are offered when there are some.

when: how long have i been on shift
how long have i been working
replies: I can't time your shift, but your Money tab shows what you've earned today.
I don't keep a clock on you. Your Money tab shows today's earnings, which is a good guide.

when: how long do i have to accept
how long is the offer open
how many seconds do i have
how long does an offer last
replies: You have sixty seconds to say yes. The seconds left are shown on the offer.
Sixty seconds. If nobody accepts in time, it moves on to the next Runner.
The sixty seconds ran out, so it went to the next Runner. Stay on shift and another will come.
Don't worry. Offers move on after sixty seconds. Another will reach you in turn.

when: what does a job offer tell me
replies: How many things are on the list, about how much shopping, how far away, and your pay of {runnerPay}.
The number of things, roughly what the shopping costs, the distance, and what you earn: {runnerPay}.
The offer shows the distance in miles before you accept.
Look at the offer. The distance is there, so you can decide before saying yes.

when: what will i get for this one
replies: This job pays {runnerPay}, like every standard delivery.
{runnerPay}, the same as every standard job, whatever is in the basket.
Press take this job on the offer. Once you do, it's yours.
Great. Press take this job, then head to the shop.
Press not this one, and it goes to somebody else. No problem.
That's fine. Press not this one, and it moves on to the next Runner.

when: will i get in trouble for saying no
is there a penalty for declining
replies: Saying not this one is fine. It simply goes to the next Runner.
You can let an offer go. Take the jobs you can do well.

when: why was i offered this job
replies: Jobs go round in turn to Runners on shift near the shop.
Fairly, one Runner after another, among those on shift nearby.

when: can i do two orders at once
can i take another job while on this one
replies: One job at a time. As soon as this one is delivered, you can take the next.
Just one at a time, so each Shopper gets your full care.
Stay on shift. Jobs near you appear on your Today tab as soon as they're offered.
When there's one near you, it pops up on your Today tab. Keep your shift on.

when: why don't i get car jobs
replies: Only jobs that suit how you're travelling today are offered. Car jobs need valid insurance on file.
Check how you're delivering today, on your Today tab. Driving needs your licence and insurance checked and in date.

when: how much shopping is in a job
how many bags will there be
replies: One delivery carries up to {maximum} of shopping, about four or five carrier bags.
At most {maximum} of shopping. That's what one Runner can carry safely on foot or onto a bus.

when: what kind of jobs are there
replies: Shopping jobs: you buy the Shopper's list at the shop and bring it to their door.
You shop the list, pay at the till, and deliver it with care to the Shopper.

when: can i cancel a job i accepted
i can't do this job now
replies: Report a problem on the job straight away, so it can be passed on and the Shopper isn't left waiting.
Tell us at once with report a problem on the job. The sooner we know, the sooner we can sort it.

when: how will i know about a job
will i be told when there's a job
replies: A new offer appears on your Runner page as an alert, and a screen reader reads it out.
It shows on your Today tab while you're on shift, with the seconds left to say yes.
Each job has a reference that links it to the order. Use it if you report a problem.
It's the job's own number. You'll see it in your Jobs tab with the date, area and pay.
Start shopping, put in what the till said, set off, and delivered. One button for each.
Press I have started shopping, then put in the till total, then I am on my way, then I have delivered it.
Look under Next on your job. It shows the one button for the step you're on.
Your job shows the next step as a single button. Press it when you've done that part.
Press I have started shopping, then work through the list.
Great. Start shopping on your job, and go through the list one thing at a time.
The list is on your job, under The list, with each thing and how many.
Open your job. Every thing to buy is listed there with its quantity.
The number is beside each thing on the list.
Each line on the list starts with how many to buy.

when: which shop do i go to
replies: The shop is on your job. Go there, and only there, unless we ask otherwise.
Check your job for the shop. If it's closed, report it rather than going elsewhere.

when: can i go to a different shop
replies: Please use the shop on the job. If there's a real problem with it, report it and we'll sort it out.
Stick to the shop on the job unless we ask you to change.

when: can i get a different brand
replies: Buy what's on the list. If it isn't there, press cannot find it and let the Shopper decide.
The Shopper chose it, so it matters to them. Ask before buying anything different.

when: they only have a bigger size
they only have a smaller pack
replies: Ask the Shopper with cannot find it. They decide.
Don't guess. Ask the Shopper from your job, and they'll say what they'd like.

when: the price is different on the shelf
it costs more than the app said
replies: That's fine. Prices in the app are estimates. The Shopper pays what the till says.
Buy it as normal. The Shopper is charged the till total, not the estimate.

when: can i get the reduced one
replies: Buy what's on the list. The Shopper pays the till price, so any saving at the till is theirs.
Stick to the list. If the till gives a saving, the Shopper gets it, because they pay what the till says.

when: how do i pick good fruit
replies: Choose as you would for someone you love. Firm, fresh, no bruises, and the longest date you can find.
Take a moment over it. Many of our Shoppers can't check it themselves, so pick the best there is.
Pick the longest date on the shelf. Our Shoppers may not be able to read the label.
Yes, always. Reach to the back for the longest date.
Pick an undamaged one. If they're all damaged, ask the Shopper with cannot find it.
Leave the damaged one. Take a good one, or ask the Shopper if there isn't one.
Open the box and check none are cracked before you buy.
Swap the box for one with every egg whole. Then pack them on top.

when: when do i pick up frozen food
what order do i shop in
what should i pick up last
replies: Pick up chilled and frozen things last, and pack them straight into the cool bag.
Cupboard things first, fresh next, chilled and frozen last.

when: how do i pack the bags
how should i bag it up
replies: Heavy things at the bottom, soft things and eggs on top, cold things in the cool bag.
Tins and bottles first, bread and eggs on top, and keep cleaning things away from food.
One thing at a time. You've got this.
Take it aisle by aisle. A big shop done well makes someone's whole week.

when: i don't know what this item is
what is this thing on the list
replies: Ask a member of shop staff, or press cannot find it to ask the Shopper.
Shop staff are usually glad to help. If they're not sure either, ask the Shopper.

when: should i ask someone in the shop
can i ask a shop assistant
replies: Yes. You're buying as an ordinary customer, so ask as anyone would.
Of course. A quick question to the staff can save a lot of time.
Take the care it needs. Getting it right matters more than speed.
Steady is fine. A careful shop is better than a quick one.

when: they'll only let me buy two
replies: Buy what the shop allows, and ask the Shopper about the rest with cannot find it.
Follow the shop's limit. Let the Shopper know from your job.
Well done. Pay at the till, then put in the till total from the receipt.
Brilliant. Check the list once more, pay, and put in what the till said.
Go back for it before you pay if you can. Check the list once more before the till.
No problem. If you've already paid, tell the Shopper honestly and report a problem on the job.
Go through the list on your job one more time, item by item.
Read down the list on your job and tick each one off in your head.

when: how many is a bag of loose
replies: Get as close as you can to what's asked. The Shopper pays the till price.
Weigh it close to what's on the list. If you're unsure, ask the Shopper.
Leave it out. We never buy alcohol, tobacco or medicines. Report it from your job so we know.
Don't buy it. Alcohol, tobacco and medicines are never part of a job.

when: can i buy a lottery ticket for them
replies: No. Nothing age restricted is ever bought on a job.
That one's not allowed. Leave it out, kindly.

when: can i get them some cash
replies: No. We never carry cash, so there's no cashback.
Cash is never part of a job, not even cashback.

when: can i do my own shopping at the same time
can i buy my own stuff too
replies: Please keep the Shopper's shopping on its own, with its own receipt, so the till total is only theirs.
Do your own shop separately, afterwards. The Shopper's receipt must be only their things.
Stay patient. If it will make you much later, a quick call to the Shopper through the app helps.
Queues happen. Let the Shopper know through the app if it's a long wait.

when: how do i do a good job
replies: Follow the list exactly, pick the freshest, ask before any swap, and pack with care.
Shop as if it were for your own family. That's the whole secret.

when: there's a lot of heavy stuff
lots of bottles on the list
replies: Pack heavy things low and spread them between bags. Take two trips to the door if you need to.
Share the weight between bags, and lift with care.

when: how do i ask the shopper about an item
how do i send a question
replies: Press cannot find it beside the thing on the list. The Shopper is asked on their own screen.
Use the cannot find it button on that line. Their answer comes back to your job and is read out.

when: the shopper isn't answering my question
replies: Carry on with the rest of the list. If time runs out with no answer, leave it out. They aren't charged for it.
Their answer will appear on your job. No answer in time means leave it out.

when: how long do i wait for an answer
how long do they have to answer
replies: The time left is shown under the question. Carry on shopping while you wait.
Your job shows how many minutes are left. Keep going with the rest of the list.
Pick the closest thing: same kind, similar size and price. If you're unsure, call them from the job.
Choose what they'd most likely pick themselves. When in doubt, a quick call settles it.

when: the shopper doesn't want a swap
replies: Then leave it out. They won't pay for it.
Leave it on the shelf. They're only charged for what you buy.

when: can i call about a substitute
can i talk to the shopper about it
replies: Yes. Press the call button on your job. The Shopper decides.
Of course. Call them through the app and talk it through.

when: nothing on the list is here
most of it is out of stock
replies: Ask about each one, and call the Shopper if it's a lot. Report a problem if the order can't sensibly go ahead.
Call the Shopper first. If the shop can't serve the order, report a problem from the job.
Good. Buy it, unless the Shopper has already said leave it out.
Great. Pop it in, as long as they haven't told you otherwise.

when: the shopper wants to add something
can i add things to the list
replies: Only what's on the job is bought. The Shopper can place another order in the app, even while this one is going.
Stick to the list. They can order more in the app; it won't hold up this job.
No. Never guess. The Shopper decides every swap.
Please don't. Ask first, every time. That's our promise to Shoppers.

when: the shopper won't pick up about the swap
replies: If the Shopper can't be reached, the item isn't bought, and they aren't charged for it.
Then leave it out. Never swap without their yes.

when: how do i put in the till total
where do i type the total
replies: On your job, under what did the till say, type the total from the receipt in pounds and pence. Then press put in the till total.
Type the receipt total into your job, then press put in the till total.

when: do i have to enter the total first
why do i enter the total before leaving
replies: Yes. The till total goes in before you set off, because that's what the Shopper is charged.
It must go in before I am on my way. The Shopper pays exactly that amount.

when: i made a mistake with the total
i put in the wrong amount
replies: Report a problem on the job straight away and give the right total. Keep the receipt.
Tell us at once through report a problem, with a photo of the receipt, and we'll put it right.

when: the till didn't print a receipt
replies: Ask the till for a copy if you can. If not, report a problem on the job and explain.
Ask the shop to reprint it. If that's not possible, tell us in report a problem.

when: take a picture of the receipt
replies: It does no harm to keep a photo. If anything is questioned, you can add photos to a problem report.
A quick photo is a good habit. Then hand the receipt over with the shopping.

when: do i give the receipt to the shopper
replies: Hand it to the Shopper with the shopping. It's theirs.
The receipt goes to the Shopper, in with the bags.

when: how do i type the amount
replies: Type it as on the receipt: pounds, a dot, then pence. For example, twelve point three four.
Just the numbers from the receipt, with a dot before the pence.

when: it was cheaper than the estimate
replies: Good news for the Shopper. Enter what the till says. They pay the till price.
Put in the real total. The Shopper is charged exactly what the till said.

when: the total is over the maximum
it came to more than the limit
the shopping is over the limit
replies: One delivery carries up to {maximum} of shopping. If the till is going well over, call the Shopper before you pay, and report a problem.
Stop and call the Shopper through the app before paying. Then tell us in report a problem.

when: how much does the shopper pay
replies: The till total for the shopping, plus the delivery fee of {fee}.
What the till says, and a flat delivery fee of {fee}. Of that fee, {runnerPay} is yours.

when: do i take money from the shopper
do i collect payment at the door
replies: No. Shoppers pay before you're sent. Never take money at the door.
Nothing changes hands at the door except the shopping. Payment is all done in advance.

when: pay with cash at the till
how do i pay at the till
replies: Follow the payment steps on your job. And never take cash from a Shopper.
Your job explains how to pay at the till. Cash from Shoppers is never part of it.

when: my card was declined at the till
replies: Don't worry. Report a problem on your job straight away, and we'll help.
Stay calm, step aside, and report a problem from the job. Don't leave the shopping unpaid in the bag.

when: i've been overcharged at the till
replies: Ask the till staff to put it right before you leave, then enter the final total.
Shops fix scanning mistakes at the till or the service desk. Enter the corrected total.
Great. Put in the till total, then press I am on my way.
Well done. Till total in, then set off.
Payment is taken before you're sent, and the final charge is set to what the till said.
Every job is paid for before it reaches you. Nobody is sent to an unpaid order.
Press I am on my way on your job, so the Shopper knows you're coming.
Safe travels. Press I am on my way if you haven't yet.
The address is on your job, under where it goes.
Open your job. The delivery address is under where it goes.
Use your usual map app with the address on your job.
Put the address from your job into your map app, and take the safest route.
Check the address on your job, and call the Shopper through the app if you need help finding the door.
A quick call through the app often helps. Shoppers know their own doors best.

when: how do i get into the building
replies: The flat number is in the address. Read the doorstep note too; it may say how to get in.
Check the doorstep note, and call the Shopper through the app if the entrance is locked.
Knock firmly, then call the Shopper through the app to say you're outside.
Call them from your job and let them know you're at the door.
Press I have delivered it. You've earned {runnerPay} for this one.
Well done. Press I have delivered it, and you're free for the next job.
Once the shopping is in the Shopper's hands, or where they asked for it.
After the handover, not before. Then press I have delivered it.

when: can i leave it on the doorstep
can i leave it by the door
replies: Only if the doorstep note says so. Otherwise hand it over in person.
Follow the doorstep note. If it doesn't say leave it, wait and hand it over.

when: can i leave it with a neighbour
replies: Only if the Shopper tells you to. Call them through the app to check.
Ask the Shopper first, through the app. Never hand it to someone they haven't named.

when: what do they want at the door
replies: It's what the Shopper asked for at the door, in their own words. It's on your job under where it goes.
Look under where it goes on your job. It says, in their words, what they'd like at the door.
Knock, say your name and that you're from {product}, and wait patiently.
Then keep it simple: knock, introduce yourself, and give them time to reach the door.

when: they want me to put it away
can i put the shopping in the fridge
replies: If they ask and you're comfortable, yes, only as far as they need. Tell them where each thing goes.
That's a kind help. Say what you're putting where, then say goodbye.
Yes, to their door. Take care on the stairs; two trips is better than a fall.
Bring it to the door, one safe trip at a time.
Wait outside and call the Shopper through the app. Ask them to put the dog away first.
Stay back and call them. Never go near a dog you're unsure of.

when: can i stroke the guide dog
